objectives: The goal of this course is to provide a comprehensive, mathematically rigorous foundation in classical electromagnetic theory. Students will master advanced analytical techniques to solve complex boundary-value problems, understand the relativistic formulation of electrodynamics, and analyze the generation, propagation, and scattering of electromagnetic radiation.
content:
Electrostatics and magnetostatics
Boundary-value problems, multipole expansions
Maxwell equations
EM wave and waveguides
Wave optics
Special Relativity
Bremsstrahlung
